# Acceptance d462b R2 (N1). The process dies while a command step of a round item runs. The base branch is deleted on the remote.
# The next run continues the same run: the step runs again, and no step of the run is refused as out of order.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start
exec git -C origin checkout -q -b integration/r1
exec git -C origin add BASE_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C origin checkout -q main

fixture project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
subst flow/round.star

exec beehestreal item add local round/integration/r1 --title 'The round' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehestreal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star &
waitfile started
kill -KILL
wait

exec git -C origin branch -q -D integration/r1
cp body.txt second

exec sh any.sh run run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star
exec cat run.rc run.err

# CELL R2a: no recorded step of the resumed run is refused as out of order.
! grep 'UnexpectedStep' run.err
! grep 'deterministic' run.err
# CELL R2b: the step after the loss ran.
exists second.head

-- body.txt --
The round of the base.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- origin/BASE_MARKER --
base marker
-- any.sh --
# any.sh <label> <args>: runs beehestreal with the args, keeps its output in <label>.out and <label>.err and its code in <label>.rc, and always exits 0.
label=$1
shift
beehestreal "$@" > "$label.out" 2> "$label.err"
echo $? > "$label.rc"
-- flow/round.star --
def main(item):
    command(name = "work", run = ["sh", "-c", "if [ -e @WORK@/second ]; then git rev-parse HEAD > @WORK@/second.head; else echo x > @WORK@/started; sleep 20; fi"])
